messages.gcsSelectCalendar: Connect the account and choose the work calendar. A secondary calendar (for example "Work") is recommended instead of the primary one.
messages.gcsConfirmDisconnect: Disconnect this Google account? Meetings will no longer be synced. No CRM data is deleted.

errors.clientCredentialsMissing: Google Client ID or Client Secret is not configured. Set them in Administration → Google Calendar Sync → Settings.
errors.redirectUriMissing: Configure the OAuth Redirect URI, or set the Site URL in Administration → Settings.
errors.refreshTokenMissing: This account has no refresh token. Connect it to Google again.
errors.invalidGrant: The refresh token is no longer valid (invalid_grant). Connect the account again. Common causes: the OAuth app is still in Testing mode, or access was revoked.
errors.noRefreshTokenReturned: Google did not return a refresh token. Revoke access at https://myaccount.google.com/permissions and connect again.
errors.oauthStateMismatch: OAuth state does not match (possible CSRF). Start the connection again.
errors.adminOnly: Only an administrator can manage Google accounts.
errors.businessAccountExists: A Business account already exists. Only one is allowed.

tooltips.calendarId: Google calendar where events will be created. Connect the account first to load the list.
